name: negative/variant-note-on-other-type
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.count: `tag=`, `content=`, `untagged` and `tags=` are for a field that holds a Variant

name: negative/variant-tag-equals-content
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: `tag=` and `content=` must be different keys

name: negative/variant-tag-key-clash
diagnostic_contains: Json: Tagged.kind: the key `kind` is also the tag of the Variant it is a case of

name: negative/variant-tag-needs-structs
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: `tag=kind` needs every case to be a struct, and `s64` is an integer

name: negative/variant-tag-transparent-case
diagnostic_contains: Json: Wrapper: a `transparent` struct cannot be a case of a Variant tagged with `tag=kind`

name: negative/variant-tag-without-name
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: `tag=` needs a key name

name: negative/variant-tags-count
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: `tags=` must give one tag per case: it has 1 and the Variant has 2 cases

name: negative/variant-tags-empty-name
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: `tags=` has an empty tag name

name: negative/variant-tags-repeated
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: the cases `Circle` and `Rect` are both tagged `same`

name: negative/variant-untagged-with-tag
diagnostic_contains: Json: Doc.shape: `untagged` cannot be combined with `tag=` or `content=`
